response.sql: SELECT m.college AS college, SUM(i.amount) AS total_amount, CAST(SUM(i.amount) AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income) AS fraction_of_all_income FROM income i JOIN member mem ON i.link_to_member = mem.member_id JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id GROUP BY m.college

assumptions.assumption: The denominator is the sum of amount over all rows in the income table, including income with no member or no major link, as the request states.
Inner joins income -> member -> major drop income with no linked member or major. Colleges are grouped by the college name text.
The fraction is returned as a raw ratio (0 to 1) via real division, not a percentage and not rounded.
